title: Wrong Answer Buzzer
blurb: The game-show buzzer that means no, absolutely not, thanks for playing. A harsh low buzz with that unmistakable rejected energy, ready for quiz nights, group chats, and the precise moment someone confidently says something wrong. Play it out loud in an argument and the argument is legally over. Downloads free as MP3 for your edits, streams, and classroom review games.
origin: Modeled on the classic Family Feud-style rejection buzzer.
